survivors.claim: droppedLabelsFor's return ternary in genesis-driver.js was flipped (labels.length ? labels : null  →  labels.length ? null : labels), inverting the MENUS step's dropped-currency-label re-print: a real dropped label now prints the generic 'some option(s) dropped for currency' fallback instead of naming the label, while an empty/no-drop case now returns a truthy empty array instead of null. This function and its caller are entirely outside spec 03's Decisions (D1-D11) and File Plan — it belongs to an earlier spec's D4 (registry-check dropped-currency feature) and is never mentioned in this spec or its deviations record. The regression is masked because the pinned regression test 'review finding F1 (D4)' in tests/genesis/genesis-driver.test.js — created specifically to pin that a dropped label IS named in the step text — was rewritten in this same diff to assert the opposite (generic wording, not the label), so the suite stays green while re-introducing the exact defect F1 was pinning against.
survivors.impact: A session running the genesis MENUS step after a package is dropped for currency (registryExit === 1) no longer sees which package was dropped in the step text itself — it has to open the menu JSON file separately to find out, the exact usability regression the original 'review finding F1' fix existed to prevent. Because the covering test was rewritten to match the bug instead of catching it, this ships silently.
survivors.evidence: Diff hunk: '-      return labels.length ? labels : null\n+      return labels.length ? null : labels'. Executed: `node --test tests/genesis/genesis-driver.test.js` (real CLI entrypoint via runNode) passes green, including the renamed test 'review finding F1 (D4): ... the MENUS step re-print uses the generic wording for it ...' whose assert is `assert.match(step.stdout, /some option\(s\) dropped for currency/, ...)` for a case where a real, non-empty droppedForCurrency label ('zzz-fabricated-nonexistent-npm-package-9182') was seeded — i.e. the test now requires the label NOT to appear, confirming the inversion is live and pinned as intended.
